paths.name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
paths.description: Master AI fundamentals and build intelligent systems

levels.title: Python Fundamentals
goals: Learn Python syntax, data types, and control structures
Complete 15 coding challenges on LeetCode or HackerRank
Build a simple calculator or to-do list app

levels.title: Data Science Basics
goals: Learn NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib libraries
Complete a data analysis project with a real dataset
Create 3 data visualizations
resources: Public datasets from Kaggle or UCI

levels.title: Machine Learning Foundations
goals: Understand supervised vs unsupervised learning
Implement linear regression and classification models
Complete Andrew Ng ML course first 5 weeks

levels.title: Deep Learning Introduction
goals: Learn neural network basics and backpropagation
Build a simple neural network from scratch
Complete a Keras or TensorFlow tutorial

levels.title: AI Project Portfolio
goals: Build an image classifier using CNN
Create a sentiment analysis model for text
Deploy one AI model as a web app

paths.name: Web Development
paths.description: Build modern, responsive websites and web applications

levels.title: HTML & CSS Mastery
goals: Create 3 static web pages with semantic HTML
Style pages using CSS Flexbox and Grid
Make a responsive portfolio website

levels.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
goals: Learn JavaScript syntax and DOM manipulation
Build 3 interactive projects like calculator or quiz
Understand ES6+ features

levels.title: Frontend Framework React
goals: Learn React components, props, and state
Build a to-do app and weather app
Understand React hooks useState and useEffect

levels.title: Backend Development
goals: Learn Node.js and Express.js basics
Create a REST API with CRUD operations
Connect API to a database MongoDB or PostgreSQL

levels.title: Full-Stack Project
goals: Build a complete web app frontend and backend
Implement user authentication
Deploy your app to Vercel or Netlify or Heroku

paths.name: Core Engineering CS Fundamentals
paths.description: Build strong foundations in computer science and algorithms

levels.title: Programming Language Mastery
goals: Choose C++ Java or Python and master the syntax
Solve 30 easy problems on LeetCode
Understand time and space complexity Big O

levels.title: Data Structures
goals: Master arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues
Implement trees and graphs from scratch
Solve 20 medium DS problems

levels.title: Algorithms
goals: Learn sorting, searching, and recursion
Master dynamic programming basics
Complete 30 algorithm problems

levels.title: System Design Basics
goals: Understand scalability and load balancing
Learn about databases and caching
Design 3 simple systems URL shortener chat app

levels.title: Interview Preparation
goals: Solve 100+ LeetCode problems easy to hard
Practice mock interviews
Complete behavioral interview prep

paths.name: Data Science & Analytics
paths.description: Extract insights from data and build predictive models

levels.title: Statistics & Probability
goals: Learn descriptive statistics and probability basics
Understand hypothesis testing and p-values
Complete Khan Academy statistics course

levels.title: Python for Data Analysis
goals: Master Pandas for data manipulation
Create visualizations with Matplotlib and Seaborn
Complete 3 exploratory data analysis projects

levels.title: Machine Learning for Data Science
goals: Build regression and classification models
Learn feature engineering techniques
Enter a Kaggle competition

levels.title: SQL & Databases
goals: Write complex SQL queries joins and aggregations
Understand database design and normalization
Complete SQL challenges on HackerRank

levels.title: Data Science Portfolio
goals: Complete an end-to-end data science project
Create a data dashboard using Tableau or PowerBI
Present findings in a professional report
